answer.value: Gentoo penguins are the most distinctive species, characterized by the longest flippers (average 214.8 mm), highest body mass (average 4985.0 g), and uniquely shallow beak depth (average 14.6 mm). While Chinstrap penguins have the longest beaks, Gentoo shows the most consistent distinctiveness across multiple physical traits.

key_insights: Gentoo has longest flippers and highest body mass
